# `xpath_short`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
xpath_short(xml, xpath)
```

Returns a short integer value, or the value zero if no match is found, or a match is found but the value is non-numeric.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `xml_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT xpath_short('<a><b>1</b><b>2</b></a>', 'sum(a/b)');
```

Result:

```text
3
```
